entities.name: Thane Du-Moriss IV
entities.description: The human ruling wizard of Kieve, husband of Bayende; a non-planeswalker who travels the planes searching for his rival Noranda-Zang.

entities.name: Kieve
entities.description: The land ruled by Thane Du-Moriss IV.

entities.name: Noranda-Zang
entities.description: Thane's wizard rival, who transferred his soul to a new body after Thane killed him and later murdered Bayende.

entities.name: Zang's son
entities.description: Noranda-Zang's only son, a black-haired giant of a man killed by Thane.

entities.name: War of Thanopolis
entities.description: The war in which Thane defeated Noranda-Zang.

entities.name: Everlorne
entities.description: A plane ruled by Noranda-Zang's family, where Thane draws mana from the pasturelands.

entities.name: Blue Realm
entities.description: Thane's turquoise amulet used to cast spells such as summoning Nightmares.

events.summary: Thane defeated Noranda-Zang in the War of Thanopolis and thrust a sword into his heart, but Zang had prepared to transfer his soul to a new body.
events.quote: Thane defeated his rival Noranda-Zang in the War of Thanopolis and thrust a sword into his heart, ostensibly killing him.

events.summary: Noranda-Zang killed Thane's wife Bayende and their unborn son.
Thane searched the planes for Zang for seventeen years.
events.quote: For seventeen years, Thane searched for Zang.

events.summary: Thane stumbled into Everlorne and used Nightmares summoned with the Blue Realm to kill a horned octopus in a whirlwind.
events.quote: Thane used his amulet to summon two Nightmares to fight the octopus.

events.summary: Thane drove off the castle guards with a swarm of locusts and unbarred the door.
events.quote: Thane clutched the Blue Realm to summon a swarm of locusts.

events.summary: Thane cast a death spell that killed Zang's only son in revenge.
events.quote: He cast a death spell that killed Zang's son.

relations.note: Killed him with a death spell.
relations.quote: He cast a death spell that killed Zang's son.
You dare speak my father's name without fear for your very life?
